ranked_upgrades.action: Diagnose the 100 Mbps Ethernet link; try an existing gigabit port and a known-good Cat5e/Cat6 cable.
ranked_upgrades.indicative_eur: 0 with a spare working gigabit cable/port; approximately EUR 5-20 for a cable or small parts. A 100 Mbps-only switch requires different hardware.
ranked_upgrades.benefit: The active I218-V link negotiates 100 Mbps, limiting wire throughput to 12.5 MB/s before overhead. A 94.7 GB download therefore takes at least about 2.1 hours. A gigabit link can improve downloads if this link is the bottleneck, but does not improve local inference. ISP or CDN limits may remain.
ranked_upgrades.measurement: Get-NetAdapter on 2026-11-14: only active adapter Ethernet, Intel Ethernet Connection (2) I218-V, LinkSpeed 100 Mbps; Speed & Duplex is Auto Negotiation. No settings changed.
ranked_upgrades.price_evidence: LDLC Cat6 2 m product shows EUR 2.90 in stock, before shipping. Intel lists I218 as 10/100/1000BASE-T capable.

firsthand_platform_evidence.summary: Author reports GLM-5.3-Flash IQ3_S decode 9.7 to 41.0 tokens/s when migrating from Core Ultra 7 with 64 GB RAM to EPYC 7443 with 256 GB RAM. Actual 29K prefill rises 577 to 1069 tokens/s. Author attributes the major gain to eliminating per-token NVMe expert reads.
firsthand_platform_evidence.confounders: GPU count, PCIe links, RAM capacity, channels, engine versions and BIOS tuning changed. This is not a CPU-only comparison and does not justify a promised multiplier for our machine.

workstation_physical_fit.facts: Z840 x16 slots2,4,6. Slots3/4 require a second CPU. HP suggests compute cards in slots6 and2 to keep both on CPU0. Official graphics power supports two300W only with1125W PSU.
workstation_physical_fit.limitation: Power support is not proof that two consumer triple-slot AIB coolers fit. Slot6 is near chassis bottom. Verify exact GPU width, length, slot clearance, airflow and qualified power cables; risers may be necessary. Dell T7910 clearance also requires exact card inspection.
workstation_physical_fit.numa: Two GPUs on CPU0 can avoid cross-socket GPU relay, but host-expert RAM allocation and CPU workers still need measured NUMA locality.
